column1: # Apps installed on first boot by Edge1 Tools (device/khadas/edge/apps/Edge1Tools).
# build/fetch-apps.sh downloads each into ~/.cache/edge1/apps and puts it on the
# image as /system_ext/etc/edge1-preinstall/<name>.apk; on first boot they are
# installed as ordinary apps - updatable, and removable from Settings.
# Columns, tab-separated: name <TAB> sources <TAB> role
#   sources  tried in order, separated by "|":
#              fdroid:<package>             F-Droid's signed index; the APK's SHA-256
#                                           is checked against it
#              github:<owner>/<repo>:<re>   the latest release's asset matching <re>
#                                           (an arm64-v8a build preferred)
#              url:<https url>              a fixed download link
#            Non-F-Droid downloads come over HTTPS from the project's own release
#            page; the first certificate seen is pinned in the cache, and a later
#            download signed by another key is refused.
#   role     "home" makes it the default launcher once installed; "-" for none.
# More apps, or ones with no stable download link (LazyMedia Deluxe, say): drop
# the .apk into D:\android_khadas\apks (or ~/android_khadas/apks in WSL) and
# rebuild. A dropped file named like an entry here replaces that entry.
Projectivy
